data.name: Absi
data.gender_notes: Absi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is sweet, gentle, and delicate. The name Absi carries the meaning “Sweet one, delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Absi usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet one, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek to maintain their inner sweetness and calmness, even in the face of life's challenges.
data.etymology: Absi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet one, delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Absi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

In various Arab and Iranian cultures, sweetness, gentleness, and delicacy are cherished qualities admired for their ability to evoke positive emotions and foster harmony and relationships. The name Absi could be seen as a reminder of the importance of these qualities in building strong interpersonal connections and maintaining a peaceful and compassionate community.

The name Absi can be interpreted as a reflection of the spiritual ideal that a soul should strive to embody qualities of sweetness, gentleness, and delicacy in thoughts, words, and actions - offering kindness, compassion, and patience to others, and seeking refuge in Allah for one's own self. This spiritual significance of the name can serve as a constant reminder for the individual to cultivate their inner self and maintain a positive, god-conscious attitude towards life.
